title: Everyday Phrases — Ordering Room Service
scene_zh: 客房送餐 · 情境對話
title_quote: I picked up the phone by the bed.
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】🛎️ 實用客房送餐必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡800句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 800 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — Ordering Room Service
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用的客房送餐情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），從深夜撥八號內線叫送餐、一樣一樣問菜單上還有沒有、報房號九○六把帳記進房費單、約好十點半送到、餐車推進房門、擺穩小桌倒一杯冰水、追問那一壺咖啡到底怎麼算錢，一路聽到回電說湯有點涼、再換一碗熱湯。全篇八百句，不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical Ordering Room Service phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue). A tired guest dials extension eight at 9:58 p.m., checks what the late kitchen still has, charges tomato soup, a club sandwich, small fries, chocolate cake and a bottle of water to room 906, fixes delivery at 10:30, rolls the cart into the room, sets the small table by the bed, pours a glass of ice water, works out why the pot of coffee costs two fifty, and finally calls back because the soup is a little cold. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I picked up the phone by the bed.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ pɪkt ʌp ðə foʊn baɪ ðə bɛd./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Room service, good evening to you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I want to order something.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You reached the right desk, sir.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I pressed eight and it rang twice.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ prɛst eɪt ænd ɪt ræŋ twaɪs./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That key connects you to us.
dialogue.zh: 那個鍵就是接到我們這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this a free call from the room?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɪs ə fri kɔl frʌm ðə ruəm?/
dialogue.zh: 從房間打這通是免費的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, the handset felt so strange.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，這話筒感覺好奇怪。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It takes two hands to hold.
dialogue.zh: 它要用兩隻手才拿得住。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 歡迎您再回來住，李先生。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I am in room nine oh six.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ æm ɪn ruəm naɪn oʊ sɪks./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nine oh six, I have it here.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn oʊ sɪks, aɪ hæv ɪt hɪr./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I came back from a late meeting.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ keɪm bæk frʌm ə leɪt ˈmitɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 我剛開完一個很晚的會才回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So you had no dinner at all?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ju hæd noʊ ˈdɪnər æt ɔl?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Not yet, I got in late.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is good this late at night?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑt ɪz ɡʊd ðɪs leɪt æt naɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 這麼晚了吃什麼比較好？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A warm soup is nice at night.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə wɔrm sup ɪz naɪs æt naɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The tomato soup is our best.
dialogue.zh: 番茄湯是我們做得最好的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much is one bowl of that?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ ɪz wʌn boʊl əv ðæt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The tomato soup is six dollars.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will take one bowl, please.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two slices come with the bowl.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The club is our best seller.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much is the club sandwich?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you serve fries as well?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, fries come in two sizes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could you write that down, please?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I have the pad right here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the steak also on the card?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə steɪk ˈɔlsoʊ ɑn ðə kɑrd?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but steak is heavy now.
dialogue.zh: 有，不過這個點吃牛排太重了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Any cake for the sweet tooth?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cake? What kinds do you have?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 四塊五，要熱的還是涼的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cake comes in a closed box.
dialogue.zh: 蛋糕會裝在蓋好的盒子裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It waits in the box, no worry.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt weɪts ɪn ðə bɑks, noʊ ˈwɜri./
dialogue.zh: 放在盒子裡沒問題，別擔心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Drinks are next on the card.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 咖啡、茶、牛奶、果汁、蘇打水。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We have bottles and tap water.
dialogue.zh: 我們有瓶裝水和自來水。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your room has a free pitcher.
dialogue.zh: 您房間有水壺，那是免費的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I like a bottle at night.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We pour coffee in a pot.
dialogue.zh: 我們的咖啡是用壺裝的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need my own cup?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 有兩個乾淨的杯子一起送到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One call can bring it all.
dialogue.zh: 一通電話就能全部送到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My thumb is too big for this.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ θʌm ɪz tu bɪɡ fər ðɪs./
dialogue.zh: 我的拇指對這鍵來說太大。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try the side of your finger.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more thing about the phone.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The red light means a hold.
dialogue.zh: 燈一變紅，就代表先暫停。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I stay on the line?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just hold, I am not done.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Take your time, I am up.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the little pot of coffee.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Put the phone on the table.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is your kitchen, by the way?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ɪz jʊr ˈkɪtʃən, baɪ ðə weɪ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The elevator is down the hall.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 在我掛斷前還有一個問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the tomato soup still hot?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The pot sits on the back burner.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə pɑt sɪts ɑn ðə bæk ˈbɜrnər./
dialogue.zh: 湯壺擱在後面小火爐上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you still make the club?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three clubs are left, no more.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will write one club, not three.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl raɪt wʌn klʌb, nɑt θri./
dialogue.zh: 我寫一份總匯，不是三份。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the bread white or rye?
dialogue.zh: 麵包是白的還是黑麥的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: White is soft, rye has seeds.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rye is hard to chew now.
dialogue.zh: 黑麥的現在嚼起來費力。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then white bread with your soup.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the fryer on all night?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I like salt on my fries.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Salt comes in a small cup.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about eggs at this hour?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The soup will fill you up.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is an omelet on the card?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Up till eleven, like the kitchen.
dialogue.zh: 吐司做到十一點，跟廚房一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the jam sweet or sour?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One slice sits in the case.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hold it, that slice is mine.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It has your name on the tag.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt hæz jʊr neɪm ɑn ðə tæɡ./
dialogue.zh: 標籤上已經寫了您的名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Gone since nine, I am sorry.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fridge cake is not my friend.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A melon bowl is on the house.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈmɛlən boʊl ɪz ɑn ðə haʊs./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 招待就是免費的意思嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the kitchen sends it, no cost.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðə ˈkɪtʃən sɛndz ɪt, noʊ kɔst./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 我會把您這句話轉告他們。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Soda is on the card, right?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 沒有可樂，只有檸檬汽水。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bottles sit in our ice bin.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there milk for the coffee?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A small jug rides with the pot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə smɔl dʒʌɡ raɪdz wɪð ðə pɑt./
dialogue.zh: 一小壺奶會跟咖啡一起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Milk or cream in that jug?
dialogue.zh: 那壺裡是牛奶還是鮮奶油？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Light cream, in a glass jug.
dialogue.zh: 是淡奶油，裝在玻璃小壺。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cream is too rich for me.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two sticks sit on the tray.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 今晚的咖啡是低因的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is far for one cup.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I can fetch it, if you wait.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kæn fɛtʃ ɪt, ɪf ju weɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 一壺，一般的，馬上送上去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are the cups big or small?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Small is fine, I only sip.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The pot holds two full cups.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A fork rides with the cake.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A spoon comes for the soup.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the spoon already in it?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 蓋子會把香味悶在裡面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我鄰居可能也想要一份。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 她用過的餐盤就擱在門外。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 九樓一位很安靜的女士。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four calls, and yours is five.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I am the last one.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You are, we close with you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When do you eat, at midnight?
dialogue.zh: 你們什麼時候吃，半夜嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 我們都在半夜吃，一直如此。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 奇怪的時段餵飽餓著的人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now write the room number down.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nine zero six, top of the list.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn ˈzɪroʊ sɪks, tɑp əv ðə lɪst./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I have it, nine oh six.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that the same as my key?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt ðə seɪm æz maɪ ki?/
dialogue.zh: 這跟我房間的鑰匙一樣嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your key says nine oh six.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, I hate a wrong floor.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 跑錯樓層會浪費十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Put the name under the number.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lee, Kevin, room nine oh six.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 兩個名字、一位客人，寫清楚了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I pay with the room bill?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ peɪ wɪð ðə ruəm bɪl?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以記在房費單上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it goes on your folio.
dialogue.zh: 可以，它會記到您的房費單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 房費單，那個詞對我陌生。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is the paper you sign.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I sign at the end, right?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You sign when you leave us.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 不用現金，只要您的名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My card is still with the desk?
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ kɑrd ɪz stɪl wɪð ðə dɛsk?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will match the two names.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you need my room key now?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju nid maɪ ruəm ki naʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 你現在需要我的房卡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much is all of this?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 然後百分之十，兩塊八毛五。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it pays the night crew.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Add those two, what do I get?
dialogue.phonetic: /æd ðoz tu, wɑt du aɪ ɡɛt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 三十一塊三毛五，全在內。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, is the coffee in it?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then we will see at the end.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wi wɪl si æt ði ɛnd./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will leave one line blank.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a minimum for this?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 門檻十五美元，您超過了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tax lives in that ten percent.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 是不會再多出什麼了吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only the coffee line, I think.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You are honest, I like that.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 誠實的單會讓客人回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you print this out tonight?
dialogue.zh: 你們今晚會把它印出來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It prints at seven in the morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt prɪnts æt ˈsɛvən ɪn ðə ˈmɔrnɪŋ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will it wait under the door?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it waits in your account.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The card pays at the end.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Confirm it all, line by line.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Soup is six, club nine fifty.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is the whole list, yes.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Five lines, plus the blank one.
dialogue.zh: 五行，再加上那行空白的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You said it like a song.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 名字是我最愛聽的聲音。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you write names all night?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 整夜都坐在這椅子上寫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 那把椅子就是你的桌子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is, with one small lamp.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A lamp, a pad, a phone.
dialogue.zh: 一盞燈、一張便條、一支電話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Add it to the same bill.
dialogue.zh: 把它記在同一張帳單上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You are a calm guest, sir.
dialogue.zh: 先生，您是很沉穩的客人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Calm now, hungry ten minutes ago.
dialogue.zh: 現在沉穩，十分鐘前我餓得慌。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One last check on the floor.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right, my light will stay on.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the time, that is all.
dialogue.zh: 剩下就是時間，沒別的了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long will the whole thing take?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ wɪl ðə hoʊl θɪŋ teɪk?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 三十分鐘，實打實的時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The cook is one man now.
dialogue.zh: 現在廚房只有一位師傅。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is one man enough for all this?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz wʌn mæn ɪˈnʌf fər ɔl ðɪs?/
dialogue.zh: 一個人做得完這一些嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He has a helper for fries.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我這個鐘寫九點五十五。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I want it at ten thirty.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 是十點半，不是十點四十。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I hear thirty, loud and clear.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Half past ten, say it back.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Half past ten, on the dot.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: On the dot, what is a dot?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑn ðə dɑt, wɑt ɪz ə dɑt?/
dialogue.zh: 一分不差？那個點是什麼意思？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I wait until ten twenty.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You may sit, do not pace.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I pace, I cannot help it.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then sit and count to ten.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Shower water is hot at ten.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, the tank is small here.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dry fast, ten thirty comes soon.
dialogue.zh: 快點擦乾，十點半一下就到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So ten thirty fits me well.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It fits, we will aim there.
dialogue.zh: 合適，我們就照那個時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you hold the soup longer?
dialogue.zh: 湯可以多保溫一會兒嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten twenty there, ten thirty here.
dialogue.zh: 那邊十點二十，我這邊十點半。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tight is fine, I like tight.
dialogue.zh: 抓緊沒關係，我喜歡抓緊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then I will write both times.
dialogue.zh: 那我就把兩個時間都寫上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我的名字寫在時間旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you call before you come?
dialogue.zh: 你們來之前會先打電話嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The bell wakes the whole floor.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我門上的掛牌也收起來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will wait at the gap.
dialogue.zh: 我會隔著鏈子跟您說話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 細心才保得住這份工作。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: If I am slow, what then?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Warm, dry hands hold the pot.
dialogue.zh: 手又暖又乾，才端得住壺。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Say the time one more time.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 十點半送到，十點二十裝盤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sit when the tray is back.
dialogue.zh: 托盤送回來你就坐一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 兩點太殘忍了，你知道嗎。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I would not do that job.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 今晚九個人當中的一個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will you bring the coffee hot?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 溫的剛好配慢慢讀書的人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It does, look at the time.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will watch it for you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I hang up, ten thirty.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, come in, the chain is off.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, kʌm ɪn, ðə tʃeɪn ɪz ɔf./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You are early by one minute.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do not run with a tray.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The tray rides the cart, sir.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The wheels are loud on wood.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Put it under the front wheel.
dialogue.zh: 墊在前面那個輪子下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That rug is my best friend.
dialogue.zh: 那塊地毯真是我好朋友。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mind the lamp on the floor.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I saw it, I moved wide.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sorry, my bag is there too.
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，我的包包也放在那裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You are tall for this job.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 個子高些，端托盤就省力。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Set it down by the bed.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the blanket for the tray?
dialogue.zh: 那條毯子是給托盤蓋的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A bowl, a plate, and a cone.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə boʊl, ə pleɪt, ænd ə koʊn./
dialogue.zh: 一個碗、一個盤、一個紙筒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is the club, big as a book.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ðə klʌb, bɪɡ əz ə bʊk./
dialogue.zh: 這就是總匯，跟書一樣大。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cut in four, on the side.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, salt on the little cup.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The soup is under the lid.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take the lid, it is hot.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Steam came up like a cloud.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It smells like my mother's kitchen.
dialogue.zh: 聞起來像我媽媽的廚房。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Move the water to my side.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 還有那碗招待的哈密瓜？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Under the cloth, with two picks.
dialogue.zh: 在布下面，附兩支小果叉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 吃甜瓜用果叉，不用餐叉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Taped, with your name on top.
dialogue.zh: 貼好了，蓋上寫您的名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My name on a cake box.
dialogue.zh: 我名字竟寫在蛋糕盒上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the coffee pot under a towel?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ˈkɔfi pɑt ˈʌndər ə ˈtaʊəl?/
dialogue.zh: 咖啡壺是用毛巾蓋著嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The jug of milk is here.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 鮮奶油拿回來了，您說過的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The second is for your book.
dialogue.zh: 第二個是留給您看書用的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 每位客人說的我都會記。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The butter is in a dish.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is a pen on the tray.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ə pɛn ɑn ðə treɪ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I go, you eat, that is all.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ɡoʊ, ju it, ðæt ɪz ɔl./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, the cart will stay here?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will come at eleven ten.
dialogue.zh: 我十一點十分來收餐車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twelve is good, I will call.
dialogue.zh: 十二點好，我會打電話叫你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 還是同一把聲音，真貼心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here is four, for the tip.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is for the cloth, and the run.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz fər ðə klɔθ, ænd ðə rʌn./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you, I will split it.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 他會笑的，那個人快睡著了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 還有一件事，門口那塊墊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, the hall is yours now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, the pot is still hot?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 毛巾是溫的，再撐二十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 二十分鐘內我就自己倒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pour slow, the cup is small.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What do I call you, friend?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 安娜，客房送餐，我在七樓。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Before you go, one small thing.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The table by the wall, can it move?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈteɪbəl baɪ ðə wɔl, kæn ɪt muv?/
dialogue.zh: 牆邊那張小桌能移動嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two steps left, by the bed.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you fix a leaning table?
dialogue.zh: 你能把歪的桌腳弄好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That sound is a night sound.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A ring of water on the wood.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə rɪŋ əv ˈwɔtər ɑn ðə wʊd./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Turn it to the warm side.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two clicks, see? Now it is softer.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu klɪks, si? naʊ ɪt ɪz ˈsɔftər./
dialogue.zh: 按兩下，看見沒？現在柔和多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The menu card, where does it go?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈmɛnju kɑrd, wɛr dʌz ɪt ɡoʊ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My phone, can it reach me?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There, now I can watch the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr, naʊ aɪ kæn wɑtʃ ðə dɔr./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 湯匙要溫，這是夜班規矩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sit one second, if you can.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your shoes, your feet, the run.
dialogue.zh: 你的鞋、你的腳、還有那一趟。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Up by elevator, down by foot.
dialogue.zh: 上去搭電梯，下來用走的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two water rings, one is mine.
dialogue.zh: 桌上兩個水圈，一個是我的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You think of the table too.
dialogue.zh: 你連桌子都替我想到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A steady table, a calm guest.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Salt for the soup, or none?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: On the lap, not the table.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: On the lap, like a child.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Die? That is sad for fries.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: But the soup was first, you said.
dialogue.phonetic: /bʌt ðə sup wʌz fɜrst, ju sɛd./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I said soup, I was wrong.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Once a night, to a guest.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 兩隻手，慢慢來，杯子要熱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 要鮮奶油還是那小壺牛奶？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two sugars, yes, I did ask.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 一包已經進了，一包還留著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The glass sweats on the wood.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 轉一下，我的杯墊撐得住。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A small brush, in the cart.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A cart is a small shop.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then what is that last number?
dialogue.zh: 那最後一個數字是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That one is the coffee pot.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I should have said that.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The coffee line, read it to me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈkɔfi laɪn, rid ɪt tə mi./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One fifty for a whole pot?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A late pot costs one more.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why is a night pot dear?
dialogue.zh: 為什麼夜裡的壺比較貴？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A man stays to brew it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Brew one pot, pay one dollar.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fair, I had a late meeting.
dialogue.zh: 合理，我開會也開到很晚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 三十一塊三毛五，再加它。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Plus two fifty, that is it?
dialogue.zh: 再加上兩塊五，就到總數了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 就成了三十三塊八毛五。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 三十三塊八毛五，你慢慢講。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it, I wrote it down.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 我這張便條被你寫滿了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the fee in the ten percent?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə fi ɪn ðə tɛn pərˈsɛnt?/
dialogue.zh: 那塊錢也算進百分之十嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 在外面，那就不會再生利？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 現在來說我那碗哈密瓜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twice, but is it on the paper?
dialogue.phonetic: /twaɪs, bʌt ɪz ɪt ɑn ðə ˈpeɪpər?/
dialogue.zh: 講過兩次，可是單子上有嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 自來水是免費的，記得嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我記得，這是我自己挑的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the ice on the bill?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The tip I gave, is that here?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə tɪp aɪ ɡeɪv, ɪz ðæt hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 我給的小費，會出現在單上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 現金小費不會印在單上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So four dollars, gone from me.
dialogue.zh: 那四塊就從我口袋飛走了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three ways, and I never met them.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri weɪz, ænd aɪ ˈnɛvər mɛt ðɛm./
dialogue.zh: 分給三個人，我一個都沒見到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 師傅已經知道您的名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 他說，要讓那位客人吃飽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 喂飽那個人，真是好廚師。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 他煮的就是夜貓子的飯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the service charge a tip?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, that fee is the house.
dialogue.zh: 不是，那筆費是給店裡的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 是給店家，不是給做事的人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So I tipped, and I also paid?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ aɪ tɪpt, ænd aɪ ˈɔlsoʊ peɪd?/
dialogue.zh: 所以我既給了小費，也付了費？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 多數晚上是四塊或五塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 星期三，是我在這裡的最後一天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Noon, so this bill comes too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The big paper, with the room?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will you leave a copy here?
dialogue.zh: 你會留一份副本在這裡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then it waits on the desk.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Desk, I will note it down.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You note a lot for me.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 溫暖是我們最便宜的招。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the cake cost extra tonight?
dialogue.zh: 蛋糕今晚還要另外加錢嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I leave the cup out?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Anna, it is nine oh six again.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈænə, ɪt ɪz naɪn oʊ sɪks əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 安娜，是我，九○六又打來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 沒弄壞東西，只有那碗湯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is a bit cold, friend.
dialogue.zh: 它有那麼一點涼了，朋友。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 沒冰過，只是沒有蒸氣了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I plated it at ten twenty.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 十點二十裝盤，十點二十九送到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So soup has a short clock.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 湯要五分鐘，不是九分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I am not a soup man.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You are a soup man now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 兩分鐘，然後又要走九分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do not run with a pot.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The bowl, and a new lid?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the second bowl, is it free?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə ˈsɛkənd boʊl, ɪz ɪt fri?/
dialogue.zh: 換來的那一碗呢？也要錢嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The six stays on the bill.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, I like a fixed bill.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How will you find me again?
dialogue.zh: 你等下怎麼認得我這間？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then I will talk through the chain.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪ wɪl tɔk θru ðə tʃeɪn./
dialogue.zh: 那我就隔著鏈子跟您講。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Soup, I will say, then open.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: While I wait, the sandwich is great.
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪl aɪ weɪt, ðə ˈsænwɪtʃ ɪz ɡreɪt./
dialogue.zh: 等的時候，三明治真好吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The club is our proud dish.
dialogue.zh: 總匯是我們最得意的菜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the melon, cold and sweet.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I ate like a tired man.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The cake waits for the tea.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You did, so bring the pot.
dialogue.zh: 你有說，那把壺也一起帶來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 過了六分鐘，也許七分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What bread came on the tray?
dialogue.zh: 托盤上放的是哪一種麵包？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 白麵包兩片，不是黑麥的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rye went back to the shelf.
dialogue.zh: 黑麥的已經放回架子了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The shelf, the salt, the pepper.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stubborn, yes. It keeps soup hot.
dialogue.zh: 是固執，可這樣才保得住熱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There it is, the soft knock.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Soup, I said, here you are.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now eat, I take the cold one.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ it, aɪ teɪk ðə koʊld wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 現在吃吧，涼的那碗我帶走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The tea, when does it come?
